limitations.zh: 本页依据一项正模描述及其比较分析，不是完整物种专论。翼展、软组织功能、食性与更细的系统关系仍为受样本和方法限制的解释；分布仅有这里说明的材料背景，不推出生殖、群居、迁徙或种群数量。PBDB 与 COL 概念分开保存。正文为来源限定的编辑整理，未经过外部领域专家评审。
limitations.en: This page draws on one holotype description and its comparative analyses, rather than a complete species monograph. Wingspan, soft-tissue function, diet and finer relationships remain interpretations limited by specimen and method. The locality context does not establish reproduction, sociality, migration or population size. PBDB and COL concepts remain separate. This is source-bounded editorial prose without external expert review.
